shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,200p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs candidates ---'; find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | rg -i 'partial|prerender|cache|dynamic|suspense' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- AGENTS ---'; cat AGENTS.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- next config ---'; cat next.config.ts; for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/CardStats.tsx; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'%s\\n' '--- PPR docs ---'; sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- cache migration docs ---'; sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | rg 'cache-components|blocking-prerender|use-cache|cacheLife|suspense|loading' | sed -n '1,200p'; printf '\\n--- guide headings ---\\n'; rg -n '"'^#{1,3} |Suspense|shell|dynamic|cacheLife|use cache'"' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | sed -n '1,220p'; printf '\\n--- blocking message ---\\n'; f="'$(find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | rg '"'blocking-prerender-dynamic' | head -1); echo \""'$f"; test -n "$f" && sed -n '"'1,320p' \""'$f"; printf '"'\\n--- cache components config ---\\n'; f="'$(find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | rg '"'cacheComponents' | head -1); echo \""'$f"; test -n "$f" && sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"'

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- prerendering guidance ---'; rg -n -C 5 'Prerendering|static shell|Suspense|uncached' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/caching-and-revalidating.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/caching.md 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,260p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- loading guidance ---'; sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/loading.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- use cache key sections ---'; rg -n '"'^##|fetch|Suspense|cacheLife'"' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/bash -lc "npm run build && printf '\\n--- git diff --stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\n--- route artifacts containing shell text ---\\n' && rg -l 'Loading chart|Total Revenue|Latest Invoices' .next/server | sed -n '1,40p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; printf '\\n--- package diff ---\\n'; git diff -- package.json; printf '\\n--- tsconfig diff ---\\n'; git diff -- tsconfig.json; printf '\\n--- shell html excerpt ---\\n'; rg -o '.{0,100}(Dashboard|Loading chart|Loading invoices|Total Revenue).{0,160}' .next/server/app/index.html | sed -n '1,30p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
     }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit
git diff --check
printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'
git status --short
printf '\\n--- focused diff ---\\n'
git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx tsconfig.json
"

/bin/bash -lc "rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,140p'
printf '\\n'
nl -ba app/DashboardSkeletons.tsx | sed -n '1,180p'
printf '\\n'
nl -ba app/loading.tsx | sed -n '1,60p'
printf '\\n--- final status ---\\n'
git status --short"
